descripcion_geo: Mountainous region northwest of Persia, between the Caspian and Mesopotamia. The Medes formed a powerful kingdom allied with Babylon.
importancia_estrategica: Empire that helped bring down Nineveh and later merged with Persia under Cyrus the Great.

historias.descripcion: The Medes allied with Babylon destroy Nineveh, capital of Assyria; Nahun's prophecy is fulfilled.

historias.titulo: The cities of the Medes: destiny of the Israelite exile
historias.descripcion: The Assyrian king deported the northern tribes of Israel to the cities of the Medes.
Darius the Mede receives the kingdom of Babylon; he issues an edict prohibiting prayer to any god except the king, leading Daniel to the lions' den.

personajes.descripcion: Median monarch who received the Babylonian kingdom; allowed the plot against Daniel.
Babylon ally; destroyed Nineveh fulfilling the prophecies of Nahún.
He survived the lions' den under the Median king Darius.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Empire that was an instrument of divine judgment on Assyria; The deported Israelites lived with the Medes in exile.

judaismo.descripcion: Daniel survives the lions' den under the Median king Darius; sign of God's power over empires.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Daniel survives the lions' den under the Median king Darius; sign of God's power over empires.
